title: Equipment & Vehicle Loans Servicing Terms: Deferral of an Installment
content:
## Terms in force

1. **What may be deferred.** On the member's request, one scheduled installment of an Equipment & Vehicle Loans loan may be deferred to the end of the schedule on a product that offers deferral.
2. **Lead time.** A deferral request must be registered at least the product's deferral request lead days in calendar days before the due date of the installment to be deferred. The days are counted backwards from that due date as calendar days, the due date itself being day 0, and the last qualifying day is the one exactly that many days earlier.
3. **Spacing.** A deferral may be granted no earlier than the product's deferral spacing in calendar months after the last deferral was granted, counted from the last deferral date to the same day of the target month (the last day of that month when the day does not exist), that day itself qualifying.
4. **Operating credit.** A deferral may be granted only when the member holds no operating line in suspended status (the count of the member's suspended operating lines is 0), because frozen operating credit puts the whole relationship under loan-officer review.
5. **Further requirements.** It further requires that the loan is in active status with no past-due installment, that at least the product's minimum number of installments have been paid in full since funding, that the loan's deferral count is below the product's lifetime deferral limit, and that the test of the cross-collateral clause is met.
6. **Effect.** Interest keeps accruing through the deferral and is billed with the next installment; the maturity date moves out by one installment period. The deferral ends, and the loan returns to active status, when the next installment comes due.

## Records each requirement is read from

| Requirement | Record it is read from |
|---|---|
| Lead time | the due date of the installment to be deferred — the loan's next due date on record |
| Spacing | the loan's last deferral date on record |
| No frozen operating credit | the status of every operating line held by the same member |
| Active, nothing past due | the loan's status and its installment due dates |
| Installments paid since funding | the installments paid in full since funding |
| Lifetime limit | the loan's deferral count |

## Lead time on both sides of the boundary

Hypothetical: a lead time of 10 calendar days and an installment due 20 June (day 0).

| Request registered on | Days before the due date | Lead time met |
|---|---|---|
| 9 June | 11 | yes |
| 10 June | 10 (the last qualifying day) | yes |
| 11 June | 9 | no |

## Spacing on both sides of the boundary

Hypothetical: spacing of 12 calendar months.

| Last deferral granted | First day a new deferral may be granted | The day before |
|---|---|---|
| 31 March 2025 | 31 March 2026 (qualifies) | 30 March 2026 (does not qualify) |
| 29 February 2024 | 28 February 2025, February 2025 having no 29th (qualifies) | 27 February 2025 (does not qualify) |

## Clauses no longer in force

- "the product's deferral fee is assessed on the grant date" — no longer in force; superseded by the current basis for the fee booked on a deferral grant.

The deferral figures named in these terms — whether deferral is offered, the lead days, the spacing in months, the minimum installments paid, the lifetime limit and the deferral fee — remain those of the product's deferral terms table.

superseded_clauses: deferral_fee_usd is assessed on the grant date
